fullPassage: Gary Graffman was born in New York City in 1928 and began playing the piano at the age of three. When he was seven, he entered the Curtis Institute of Music, where he received training that laid the foundation for his career. In 1949, he won the Leventritt Award and then played concerts worldwide. In the late 1970s, Graffman lost control of the fingers on his right hand, but he never gave up playing the piano. Reconsidering the traditional piano performance convention of using both hands, he focused on works for the left hand alone, such as Ravel's Piano Concerto for the Left Hand. Graffman returned to the Curtis Institute of Music in 1980 as a member of the piano faculty. There he taught many outstanding young musicians, including Lang Lang, and his lifelong commitment to music continues to inspire people today.

questions.stem: 윗글에 관한 설명으로 가장 적절한 것은?
ch: Graffman의 어린 시절 가족 환경을 소개하고 있다.
피아노 연주의 기술적 발전 과정을 설명하고 있다.
Curtis Institute of Music의 역사를 설명하고 있다.
역경을 극복한 피아니스트의 생애를 소개하고 있다.

det.ref: lost control ... never gave up ... focused on works for the left hand ... continues to inspire
det.correct: ④ 오른손 통제력 상실이라는 역경을 극복하고 왼손 작품에 집중하며 교육자로 전환한 Graffman의 생애
wrongs: ① 가족 환경 언급 없음
② 기술적 발전이 아닌 개인 생애
③ 학교 역사가 아닌 인물 소개
det.tip: 인물 소개글: 생애 → 업적 → 역경 극복 → 현재 영향

questions.passage: Gary Graffman was born in New York City in 1928 and began playing the piano at the age of three. When he was seven, he entered the Curtis Institute of Music, where he received training that laid the foundation for his career. In 1949, he won the Leventritt Award and then played concerts worldwide. In the late 1970s, Graffman lost control of the fingers on his right hand, but he never gave up playing the piano. Reconsidering the traditional piano performance convention of using both hands, he focused on works for the left hand alone, such as Ravel's Piano Concerto for the Left Hand. Graffman returned to the Curtis Institute of Music in 1980 as a member of the piano faculty. There he taught many outstanding young musicians, including Lang Lang, and his lifelong commitment to music continues to inspire people today.
questions.stem:
다음 요약문의 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

Gary Graffman overcame the (A) of losing control of his right hand by focusing on left-hand piano works, and later became an influential (B) at the Curtis Institute of Music.

det.ref: lost control ... never gave up ... member of the piano faculty ... taught many outstanding young musicians
det.correct: ② challenge(도전/역경) + educator(교육자): 오른손 통제력 상실이라는 도전을 극복하고 교육자가 됨
wrongs: ① advantage(이점) + student: 이점이 아닌 역경, 학생이 아닌 교수
③ competitor(경쟁자): faculty member는 교육자
④ privilege(특권): 통제력 상실은 특권이 아님
det.tip: challenge(도전) + educator(교육자) = 역경 극복 + 교육 헌신
